questions.prompt: Which hand calls a large river bet from an unknown more often?

choices.text: Top pair, strong kicker, on a dry board where missed draws are possible.
Bottom pair against a nit’s overbet

questions.explanation: Bluff-catch with hands that beat the misses, not with air, and not against a range that never misses.

questions.prompt: A river check-raise from a quiet player is…

choices.text: A mandatory call with any pair

questions.explanation: Live check-raises on the river are the nuts far more often than a bluff.

questions.prompt: Pot odds can make a call correct when…

choices.text: You win often enough given the price, even if you are not a favorite.
You are facing a bet of your entire stack with 72

questions.explanation: A tiny bet can be called with a bluff-catcher that should fold to an overbet.

choices.text: Does my hand beat bluffs, beat value, or beat neither, and does this opponent bluff?
Did I win the last hand
How many chips are in the rack

questions.explanation: Hand class plus opponent. That is the decision. Chip results do not grade it.
